links.comparator_used: Automated network detection alone, with every prediction output and no manual assessment branch (implied; the abstract gives no network-only figure for the full framework)
links.outcome: Pain-event detection accuracy and recall, with low-confidence cases routed to manual assessment
links.effect: Overall framework accuracy reached 82.35% with the manual assessment branch; the abstract says integration increases recall of true pain events but gives no network-only figure for comparison
links.tradeoff: Borderline or hard cases still need manual nurse evaluation, so some human workload remains.
links.quote: Experimental results show our neural network sur- passes state-of-the-art algorithms by at least 25% in accuracy on the MNPAD dataset, with overall framework accuracy reaching 82.35% with integration of manual assessment branch.

links.comparator_used: Uniform manual evaluation of all cases (implied by the claim of reduced manual effort)
links.outcome: Manual evaluation effort and recall of true pain events
links.effect: Reported qualitatively: the integration increases recall and reduces manual evaluation effort; no numbers are given for the effort reduction
links.quote: The integration of both machine detection and manual evaluation can increase the recall rate of true pain events, reduce the manual evaluation effort, and increase public trust in such applications.

design_hint: Manual clinician review of low-confidence cases
